question: On 24-25 February 2025, where did the International Conference on Carbon Markets Prakriti 2025 take place?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **International Conference on Carbon Markets Prakriti 2025** was held on **24-25 February 2025** in **New Delhi**, the capital city of India.
 
• **New Delhi** is a hub for national and international conferences, being the seat of the **Indian government** and home to key institutions and organizations.
 
• This conference focused on discussions related to **carbon markets**, a mechanism aimed at reducing greenhouse gas emissions through tradeable permits and credits.
